text:
sarah: kicking off deploy v3.2.1 now. feature flag 'llm-route-v2' will be rolled with a slow ramp. planned window 02:00-03:00 UTC. 

deploy-bot: pipeline queued — build #7821. (queued by sarah)

kevin: thanks. remind me the pin strategy? are we pinning to v3.2.0 for critical cohorts?

sarah: yes — critical cohorts pinned to v3.2.0 for 15m after initial 5% ramp. then evaluate telemetry.

nora: adding telemetry checklist: 95th latency, error-rate, token-cost delta. will watch. :eyes:

pm-chris: release notes link: https://redwood/internal/releases/v3.2.1 (summary + rollback instructions)

oncall-liz: oncall here. if error-rate > 1% for 5m, toggle flag off and pin to v3.2.0. I'll trigger rollback if deploy-bot fails auto-drain.

sarah: noted. our FF plan: 0% -> 1% (2m) -> 5% (5m) -> 20% (10m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (soak). abort gates at each step.

kevin: what's the exact command to roll the flag back quickly? pasteable pls.

sarah: use the release tool: `./reltool flag toggle --name=llm-route-v2 --env=prod --state=off --reason="rollback"` then `./reltool pin --service=llm-router --version=3.2.0`

deploy-bot: build #7821 started on runner-09. tests passing: unit, integration. canary deploy scheduled.

nora: I'll run quick smoke prompts against canary when canary is up.

sarah: canary healthy. starting slow ramp to 1% now. (reaction :rocket:)

oncall-liz: watching metrics dashboard -> link https://dashboards/redwood/llm-route. ping me in this thread if thresholds hit.

pm-chris: if we need immediate kill switch, use `./reltool emergency-disable --ff=llm-route-v2` — ops has keys.

kevin: ack. will stand by to pin if Liz calls it.

nora: smoke looks good, latency within baseline. continue ramp.

sarah: progressing to 5% per plan. will post updates at each gate.

deploy-bot: canary drained and shifted to ramp pool. timestamp 4938271612.

sarah: final note — we will leave cohort pin for 30m after 100% to guard against delayed regressions. thanks team.
